source: Freddie Mac, MBA, Zillow, CME data via Real Estate News

headline: Rates fall again,
*buyers still wait*
slides.sub: A third straight weekly drop, yet purchase demand is still well below last year.
slides.fig_caption: Average 30-year fixed rate, week of Nov. 5, 2026

slides.title: 30-year fixed: *then vs. now*
slides.note: Down from roughly 7.5% a few weeks ago, but still *0.96 points* above a year ago. The 15-year sits at 6.57%.

slides.label: purchase applications vs. *last year*
slides.body: Refinance applications are down 60% year over year (MBA, week ending Oct. 30). Zillow says pending sales fell 16.8% in October, the slowest October since 2018.

slides.label: odds of a *Fed rate hike* in December
slides.body: Up from 66.9% a day earlier, after October added 165,000 jobs against a 59,000 forecast. Unemployment ticked down to 4.1%.

slides.title: Work the *window*
slides.body: Rates are easing just as the slow season starts, and a hot jobs report could push them back up. Re-run payment numbers with buyers on the fence now.
